channel.title: EdgeLine AI leans
channel.description: Sports betting leans from a game-data model: every lean with our probability and its edge over the price, every grade, every slate. Informational only; 21+.

item.title: Lean of the day: Under 6.5 +118 at FanDuel (Medium, +5.7 pts)
item.description:

Total: Under 6.5 at +118 (FanDuel). Our probability 51.5% from game data, the price implies 45.9%, edge +5.7 pts, EV +12.4% per unit. Confidence: Medium.

Our probability at 6.5 is 51.5%, from the game data: this season's results and margins, recent form, rest, the injury report and home edge (projected total 6.4). FanDuel offers +118, which implies only 45.9%. Its bar is 3.0 points (the floor: the model's own margin of error here is smaller). It clears it by 2.7.
